messages:
Alex Lee: quick RFC follow-up — we still need to pick the versioning model for adapter interfaces across hosted/dedicated/private. Do we go semver for the RPC surface or do we do feature flags per-connection?
Mira Patel: personally +1 for semver on the wire. feature flags are great for toggles but they don't solve incompat contract.
Toni Schreiber: semver is fine but we need a runtime negotiation for incompatible minor bumps. think: client declares capabilities, server replies with accepted subset + suggested fallback.
Alex Lee: agreed. proposal: 3-layer negotiation: 1) exact major.minor match -> full features 2) compatible lower minor -> gated features disabled 3) no compat -> circuit-breaker / reject with clear error.
Mira Patel: can we encode that in a tiny handshake payload? e.g.
```
{"client_version":"1.3.0","caps":["streaming","kv_cache","trace_ids"]}
// server responds
{"server_version":"1.3.1","accepted":["streaming","kv_cache"],"fallback":"model-compact-v1"}
```
Toni Schreiber: that looks good. add a `grace_period` window for auto-downgrade so long-running clients don't break instantly.
Alex Lee: circuit-breaker behavior: if server rejects or drops more than X% of requests for N mins, controlplane should route to alternative pool (dedicated->hosted fallback) and emit metric `adapter_fallback.activations`.
Mira Patel: thresholds? start with 5% errors over 2m for noisy detection, but require >20% over 5m to auto-failover. conservative defaults but config override per-tenant.
Toni Schreiber: also need a health probe that checks feature compatibility separately from liveness. e.g., /probe?cap=kv_cache returns 200/412.
DevOps Bot: deploy scheduled: canary config will include new negotiation semantics flag `adapter_handshake_v2` — rolling next Tue.
deploy-bot: :package: canary rollout initiated on infra-dev at 2026-03-24T02:00Z
Mira Patel: action items: @Toni to draft handshake RFC snippet + probe spec (deadline Thu). @Alex to add metrics + alert playbook. I'll update SDKs to emit `client_version` header.
Alex Lee: sg. will add a short migration note for Dedicated customers about automatic fallback opt-out.
Toni Schreiber: one more: telemetry needs to tag fallbacks by reason: `compatibility`, `capacity`, `latency`. makes postmortems easier.
Alex Lee: nice. locking this as the follow-up plan. we'll reconvene after Toni's RFC draft. :thumbsup:
